description: Synthetic sesslint.repair package barrel parity (__all__ name list and order from the pinned repair/__init__.py; no session payload text).

GAP-repair-package-string-exports: PRECONDITION_FUNCS, REGISTRY, and run_all_checks appear in Python __all__ and in repair::ALL as names only; they are not re-exported as public Rust values and run_all_checks is not a Rust function.
